sentences.en: There existed insufficiency in analysis of interclass balance, evaluation of therapeutic effect, conclusion deduction, etc, which decreased the quality of RCT of TCM.

sentences.en: Does surrogacy causes a kind of interclass oppress and exploitation?

sentences.en: The interclass correlation coefficient (ICC) was used to determine the reliability.

sentences.en: The interclass difference matrix is calculated by using the fault class feature data from simulation in order to determinate the ambiguity sets.

sentences.en: The method of minimum interclass variance needs to compute conic statistic in segmenting image, which costs a large computation but has less efficiency.

sentences.en: The inter-observer and intra-observer agreement of CCT measurement by OCT were analyzed by interclass correlation coefficient (ICC).
sentences.vi: Thỏa thuận giữa các quan sát viên và nội bộ quan sát viên về phép đo CCT của OCT được phân tích bằng hệ số tương quan giữa các lớp (ICC).
